name: Crossing - target broad on port bow (own-ship stand-on)
description: Target is broad on own-ship's port bow (~60 deg relative to port). The target does not give way, so own-ship must hold course/speed under Rule 17(a)(i) and only act under Rule 17(a)(ii)/(b) if the target clearly fails to act and collision becomes otherwise unavoidable.
pass_criteria: Own-ship holds course and speed for a meaningful initial period (does not manoeuvre prematurely).
If the target never gives way, own-ship eventually takes late avoiding action under Rule 17(b) rather than colliding.
Minimum CPA stays above the safe-distance threshold.
